source_title: Stateful Artificial Intelligence (AI) runtime environment for isolated stateful execution of AI agent workflows (US20260267689A1)
possible_relevance: Pre-P1 patent publication with stateful agent runtime, execution-boundary checkpoints, serialized persistent state, suspension/rehydration/resumption, layered short/long-term memory, context-window injection/removal, custom forget/remember policies, resource security tokens/ACLs, provider-independent security enforcement, and extensible runtime drivers; strong pressure against broad checkpoint/resume, bounded-context, permission/security, and stateful-runtime formulations, especially Claims 1, 3, 9-10, 14-18
notes: Published six days before P1; secondary patent metadata reports 2025-03-06 priority and 2026-03-06 U.S. filing. Claim/description review confirms more adverse teaching than the initial intake recorded: execution-boundary suspension; serialized state and rehydration; continuation exactly where left off; dynamic injection/removal of conversation data; short/long-term memory tiers and forget/remember policies; resource-attached security tokens and agent ACL/capability checks; a central security manager standardizing checks across storage, LLM and memory drivers; and drivers abstracting LLM/storage/memory backends. Therefore do NOT treat permission-scoped resume packages, provider abstraction, generic bounded context selection, security-token enforcement, or preserved checkpoint/resume as presumptively distinguishing. Remaining candidate distinctions requiring rigorous charting include the particular three-state combination of durable person-specific world state + separately fresh Person State + independently resumable workstream state; entity/alias resolution jointly driving bounded world-slice selection; correction/supersession/provenance semantics that alter later selection; Person-State change causing feasible-action recomputation while a workstream stays frozen; and Claim 15's specific transcript-independent handoff representation containing the recited person/entity/Person-State/workstream fields. No anticipation conclusion is recorded until every operative limitation is charted. Preserve for IDS/materiality review.

source_title: Focused Probabilistic Entity Resolution From Multiple Data Sources (US11709848B2 family)
possible_relevance: Pre-P1 entity-resolution family teaching retrieval from multiple data stores, aggregation around entities, association based on attribute types/values, separately stored association metadata leaving source objects unchanged, and focusing resources on relevant entities; adverse pressure against treating generic entity resolution, entity aggregation, metadata association, or relevance-focused retrieval as distinguishing portions of Claim 1
notes: Google Patents identifies the family as continuing from application 16/562,201 and earlier application 15/242,335 filed 2016-08-19. Its disclosure expressly concerns soft entity resolution across multiple data sources and notes focusing attention/resources on relevant entities. This does NOT facially establish Claim 1's complete combination, including separately fresh Person State, independently resumable workstream state, the claimed bounded world-slice construction as a joint function of resolved entities plus current Person State plus workstream state, inference over that slice, and durable write-back. Preserve as an adverse component reference and test combination theories with MI-0004 and other pre-P1 state/runtime art; no anticipation/obviousness conclusion is recorded here.

source_title: System and Method for Dynamic Form Selection and Synchronization in a Conversational AI Interface (US20250245423A1)
source_date: 2025-07-31 publication; application states CIP of US18/135,703 filed 2023-04-17 claiming benefit of provisional 63/332,205 filed 2022-04-18
possible_relevance: Pre-P1 publication expressly combines conversational AI workflow persistence across sessions/devices with dynamic user-state/behavior modeling that changes subsequent prompt/workflow sequencing, structured durable user data, context-sensitive selection, entity extraction, correction handling, voice interaction, and human handoff with summarized context. Strong adverse pressure against broad formulations of Claims 1, 9-13 and component aspects of 15-18.
notes: The publication states users may pause/resume workflows across devices without losing progress; session state is preserved across device transitions; a user-satisfaction model uses response latency, sentiment, correction frequency and time-on-task to alter complexity, sequence, delivery format, field priority, escalation, or pause/resume behavior; dynamic form selection uses conversation history, context and user metadata; NLP performs intent recognition/entity extraction; and AI-to-human handoff supplies summarized progress/context. This is materially closer to Claim 9's Person-State-change/workstream-continuity concept than generic checkpoint art and should be charted in combination with MI-0004. Do not assume it teaches the exact claimed separation of durable world state, separately fresh Person State, and independently resumable workstream state, or the exact transcript-independent provider handoff representation. Because this is a CIP, do not assign every disclosed feature the 2022/2023 priority date without family/new-matter analysis; the 2025-07-31 publication itself is safely pre-P1 for public-disclosure prior-art review. Preserve for IDS/materiality review.

source_title: Automatically determining workstreams from common actions in online applications (US20260111815A1 / US12608668B1)

That analysis reports provisional priority 2024-10-23, U.S. filing 2025-03-11, grant publication 2026-04-21, and application publication 2026-04-23. Preserve the conservative distinction: the reviewed disclosure did not establish the claimed combination of separately lifecycle-managed durable Person State, person-specific entity/alias resolution, bounded world/context slice jointly controlled by namespace + Person State + independently resumable workstream under correction/permission/resource controls, correction/supersession semantics suppressing stale interpretation, or provider-independent restoration without the original conversation transcript. Priority entitlement for any outcome-determinative teaching still requires checking the underlying provisional. Register omission is now repaired; no anticipation or obviousness conclusion is asserted until limitation-level charting and combination analysis are complete.

source_title: Systems for and methods of context-preserving agent routing with thread-level context serialization (US12717623B1; Appl. 19/427,038)
possible_relevance: Pre-P1 U.S. patent expressly teaches a persistently associated serialized thread-level context object, conversational/workflow state variables, task dependencies, policy constraints, transfer among software agents, durable storage, reconstruction/deserialization, updates from agent outputs, access limitations, and distributed/asynchronous continuity. Strong adverse pressure against generic persistent context, serialization, cross-agent handoff, reconstruction, policy-scoped context transfer, and portions of operative Claims 14-20, especially Claim 15.
notes: USPTO Official Gazette identifies US 12,717,623 B1, application 19/427,038, filed 2025-12-19. Its claim 1 requires a persistently associated serialized conversational-state object shared across multiple software agents and updated from agent outputs; the specification expressly teaches storing/transmitting/reconstructing serialized context across process boundaries, microservices, remote agents and persistent stores, including workflow state variables, task metadata and policy constraints. This materially narrows the room for arguing that serialization, persistent context, generic agent-to-agent transfer, reconstruction, or scoped transfer are distinguishing by themselves. It does not facially establish operative Claim 15's complete recited combination: person-specific durable state stored separately from private conversation state; resolution of an active person-specific namespace and active workstream; a handoff representation requiring a person/namespace identifier, resolved entity identifier(s), current Person State, workstream identifier and workstream resume point; and reconstruction of that identified active workstream without the first runtime's private conversation state. Chart Claim 15 limitation-by-limitation and test obviousness combinations with MI-0004 and MI-0006. Preserve for IDS/materiality review; no anticipation conclusion yet.
